inputs.name: responseRecord.value
inputs.description: The value to narrow to an object record before reading response fields. It must be a non-null, non-array object; primitives, null, and arrays are rejected.

inputs.name: RemoteProjectResponseValidator.actor.value
inputs.description: The hosted response whose actor must be verified against the signed-in principal. It must contain an actor record with a matching id and emailVerified set to true.

inputs.name: RemoteProjectResponseValidator.actor.principalId
inputs.description: The signed-in principal id used to verify the hosted actor. It must exactly equal actor.id; the validator performs no format check or normalization.

inputs.name: RemoteProjectResponseValidator.projects.value
inputs.description: The hosted project list to validate before returning desktop project entries. It must be an array of records with string id and name; other response fields are discarded.

inputs.name: RemoteProjectResponseValidator.snapshot.value
inputs.description: The hosted snapshot to validate before exposing it as a read-only project snapshot. Its project id and name, revision commit, and entities, branches, and commits arrays must pass the implementation's checks.

inputs.name: RemoteProjectResponseValidator.snapshot.projectId
inputs.description: The requested hosted project id used to compare against snapshot.project.id. The comparison is exact and the validator imposes no additional id format.

inputs.name: RemoteProjectResponseValidator.entity.value
inputs.description: The hosted entity detail to validate before returning it. Its id must equal entityId, and versions, sources, and threads must be arrays.

inputs.name: RemoteProjectResponseValidator.comment.value
inputs.description: The hosted thread returned after a comment submission. Its project and collaboration commit must match the request constraints, and its thread id, anchor, and matching comment identity are checked when applicable.

inputs.name: RemoteProjectResponseValidator.comment.input
inputs.description: The comment request being acknowledged, containing projectId, requestId, anchor, text, and an optional threadId. Its anchor fields and requestId/text values are matched against the returned thread and comment.

inputs.name: RemoteProjectResponseValidator.comment.principalId
inputs.description: The signed-in principal id expected on the matching acknowledged comment. It must exactly equal the comment actor id, whose emailVerified value must be true.
